title: Andrew Berry: Denzel Ward is a huge part of the team, we like him a lot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andrew Berry: Denzel Ward is a huge part of the team, we like him a lot
sources.description: In the immediate aftermath of the blockbuster trade that sent Myles Garrett from the Browns to the Rams, there was reporting that Cleveland was a "hard no" on potentially moving another top veteran defender, cornerback Denzel Ward.
